channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Robust critical mineral supply chains vital to boost India's manufacturing goals: Ashwini Vaishnaw
item.description: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw highlighted the importance of strengthening critical mineral supply chains to boost India's manufacturing and electronics sectors during a ministerial meeting in the US. He stressed the need to address supply chain vulnerabilities through global cooperation rather than decoupling.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty open lower over US imposing 25 pc tariffs on nations trading with Iran
item.description: As of 9.29 am, Sensex slipped 85 points, or 0.10 per cent to 83,792 and Nifty eased 22 points, or 0.08 per cent to 25,768. Main broad-cap indices showed slight divergence with benchmark indices, with the Nifty Midcap 100 up 0.11 per cent, while the Nifty Smallcap 100 added 0.38 per cent.

item.title: 'Let's keep changing the game': Yash thanks Namit Malhotra, Sandeep Reddy Vanga and others for Toxic love
item.description: Rocking Star Yash celebrated his birthday with the unveiling of the teaser for Toxic: A Fairytale For Grown-Ups, which received widespread acclaim from fans and the film industry. Grateful for the overwhelming response, Yash thanked several colleagues and collaborators, with special mentions for Namit Malhotra and Sandeep Reddy Vanga for their support.

item.title: US court orders immigration authorities to facilitate return of wrongfully deported Indian
item.description: A US federal court has ordered immigration authorities to facilitate the return of Francisco D'Costa, an Indian national wrongfully deported to India despite a court order preventing his removal.

item.title: Hema Malini can't bring herself to watch Dharmendra's Ikkis: "It will be too overwhelming"
item.description: Hema Malini has revealed the real reason why she hasn't watched Dharmendra's last film Ikkis yet.

item.title: Suicide case: Bengaluru dental student harassed over skin tone, six lecturers sacked
item.description: A 23-year-old dental student, Yashaswini, from a private college in Bengaluru, died by suicide on January 8, allegedly due to harassment by lecturers over her skin tone, dressing, and minor health issues. Following an FIR and investigation, six lecturers from the Oral Medicine and Radiology department were dismissed.

item.title: Elon Musk calls Apple‑Google AI partnership 'unreasonable concentration of power'
item.description: The criticism comes amid Musk's xAI suing Apple and OpenAI over ChatGPT integration in Siri and claims that Apple's App Store disadvantages rivals like Grok. The dispute highlights ongoing AI competition, regulatory scrutiny, and Musk's efforts to expand xAI, which recently raised $20 billion and is increasing data centre capacity.

item.title: Concern over Russia's deployment of hypersonic nuclear-capable missile expressed at UNSC
item.description: The UN Security Council expressed serious concern over Russia's deployment of the nuclear-capable hypersonic Oreshnik missile near NATO's border in Poland, marking a major escalation in the Ukraine war. The missile, capable of traveling 2,300 km/h, struck targets in Lviv, worsening civilian hardships amid freezing temperatures.

item.title: Hema Malini's bond with Sunny Deol: "Happy and close to each other, he tells me whatever he does"
item.description: Hema Malini quashes rumours of rift between her and stepson Sunny Deol. Reveals he consults her on things and are cordial with each other.

item.title: Delhi-NCR hit by double whammy of biting cold and high air pollution
item.description: Delhi-NCR is facing a severe combination of cold wave and hazardous air pollution. The IMD has issued orange and yellow alerts, with temperatures dropping as low as 4°C and high humidity intensifying the chill. Meanwhile, the Air Quality Index (AQI) has reached 'severe' levels in multiple areas, including Anand Vihar (411) and Rohini (397), posing serious health risks.
